EPSE.description: Seismic Earth Pressure (EPSE). SEL_TYPE drives how the loading area is defined: SEL_TYPE=ELEM uses ELEM_LIST/NODE_LIST with ELEM_TYPE, while SEL_TYPE=GRUP uses LOADING_AREA_GROUP (which becomes mandatory at runtime for that branch).

LOADCASE.description: Static load case name this seismic earth pressure belongs to. Must match an existing static load case; otherwise the request is rejected.

DIR.description: Loading direction. 'XY' applies the load in the horizontal direction, 'NORMAL' applies it normal to the surface. Case-insensitive.

IN_PT.description: Inner point (x, y, z) used to orient/identify the loading area.

SF.description: Scale factor applied to the seismic earth pressure load.

CODE.description: Design code for the seismic earth pressure. Case-insensitive. Only 'KDS(41-17-00:2019)' is currently supported in this build.

SEIS_LOAD.description: Seismic load (Seismic Load Code) name. Must match an existing seismic load definition; otherwise the request is rejected.

LAYER_PARAM.description: Soil layer parameter used to compute ground displacement. 'SINGLE' = single layer, 'DOUBLE' = two layers, 'USER' = user-defined. Case-insensitive.

LAYER_LV.description: Top level of the 2nd soil layer (used with the double/two-layer method).

SOIL_PROP.description: Soil property definition name. Must match an existing soil property; otherwise the request is rejected.

SEL_TYPE.description: Selection type for the loading area. 'ELEM' uses selected boundary elements/nodes (ELEM_LIST/NODE_LIST with ELEM_TYPE); 'GRUP' uses a Loading Area Group (LOADING_AREA_GROUP is then required). Case-insensitive.

ELEM_TYPE.description: [SEL_TYPE=ELEM] Element type of the loading area. 'FRAME' for frame elements, 'PLANAR' for planar elements. Must match the actual element type of the elements in ELEM_LIST. Case-insensitive.

NODE_LIST.description: [SEL_TYPE=ELEM] Node numbers defining the loading area. Each must be an existing node.

ELEM_LIST.description: [SEL_TYPE=ELEM] Element numbers defining the loading area. Each must be an existing element whose type matches ELEM_TYPE.

LOADING_AREA_GROUP.description: [SEL_TYPE=GRUP] Loading Area Group name. Required (and must reference an existing group that has a loading area plane) when SEL_TYPE=GRUP.

PRES_PROFILE_ITEMS.description: Pressure profile table: one entry per level defining the seismic earth pressure distribution.

LEVEL.description: Level (elevation) of this pressure profile point.

SEIS_PRES.description: Seismic earth pressure at this level.
